items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the score
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: With a green-suite candidate serving the marker and a fresh fixture, the runner halted at gate with Built-in gate not implemented; it did not pass the cycle or record gate and scoring effects.

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 failed at fence, starting R-1 for C-2 returned run-already-started; the run list retained only R-1 for C-1.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first is running
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: While R-1’s builder slept, progress showed running and starting R-2 returned run-in-progress; the Grain store contained a run-started event only for R-1.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After a command-gated R-1 passed, starting R-2 for C-1 returned cycle-already-run and querying R-2 returned null.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: Started R-1 against a fresh fixture repository with nonexistent deadbeef commit; start-run returned not-a-commit and run-progress returned null, with no builder launched.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: An empty fixture plan produced empty-checklist at checklist; progress halted before the cycle with no self-check or fence.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: A fixture containing an unstamped third scenario recorded the stamp, then halted at stamp with stamp-identities-differ and no pin or checklist.

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The failing self-check produced the expected fence-stage failure, but progress listed a subsequent fail-cycle effect as the last effect, contrary to the scenario; its failure detail also retained a newline.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: A passing self-check printed SKIP bb-tools; its recorded harness-self-check-passed event listed bb-tools as a skipped check.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: Fencing impl plus absent harness/cycles returned fenced-path-matched-nothing, followed by fail-cycle; progress failed at fence and no builder launched.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: In the corrected fixture, the cut tree contained provided-runtime as mode 160000 at an existing commit; the builder saw one commit and no fenced paths, but git ls-tree HEAD provided-runtime returned no entry.

items.name: Each regenerate runs one builder session and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The first candidate’s red suite was followed by a repair producing a green one; the builder logged two distinct session IDs, and the gate and repair effects ran after the first launch completed.

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The required gate result was not recorded.

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The rendered instruction was sent to an empty builder; progress recorded fail-cycle for candidate-not-regenerated with no regenerate result.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: A builder sleeping 30 seconds was terminated by the two-second regenerate budget; progress failed at regenerate for budget and no owned process survived shutdown.

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: With the configured port occupied, the run halted at gate because the built-in gate was unimplemented; it did not record three seam-answered-before-boot refusals or fail its cycle for infrastructure.

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The fixture reached the built-in HTTP gate, but progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run: Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required. The required gate outcome was not recorded.

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The fixture reached the built-in HTTP gate, but progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run: Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required. The required gate outcome was not recorded.

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The fixture did not replace the served marker with a non-matching page.

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The fixture did not start the post-exit writer.

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: Repair saw the previous candidate and evidence files, but the repair effect detail named their builder-room paths rather than the gate event’s evidence-root; the fixture did not test writes from the builder.

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, no fourth builder is launched, and nothing is graded
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: The fixture reached the built-in HTTP gate, but progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run: Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required. The required gate outcome was not recorded.

items.name: An item the judge did not score is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The researcher branched on get-input item and failed 01-002; only 01-001 scored, and Measurement filed 01-002 unreached with one of two passing and the cycle passed.

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: On one store R-1 failed at fence and R-2 halted at checklist; progress reads five seconds later matched their earlier results exactly.

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: After a command-gated run passed, two progress reads returned identical objects and the run remained passed.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The probe fixture did not assert the argument and marker.

items.name: A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The suite fixture did not create and remove its temporary directory.

items.name: A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The passing self-check printed the legacy SKIP line; its recorded harness-self-check-passed event retained the complete text after SKIP.

items.name: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The probe fixture did not print the specified identity line.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The fixture did not capture probe and store-check arguments.

items.name: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The fixture did not make the stdio suite red or capture its environment.

items.name: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The probe fixture did not return the specified failure.

items.name: A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The store-check fixture did not return the specified failure.

items.name: A stdio candidate reads the spec beside it in the gate room
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The suite fixture was intended to check the plan beside it.

items.name: A stdio run whose store check cannot be started halts at the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The required gate result was not recorded.

items.name: The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Two stdio runs on one store used store-check commands ending in one and two; both first self-checks passed and recorded distinct harness digests.

items.name: A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: The 01-a symlink was stamped and checklisted, but checklist item sources were spec/a/spec.feature rather than under 01-a as required.

items.name: The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: With PLAN_SLICES=02, the stamp and checklist recorded only item 02-001 and no slice 01 item.

items.name: Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Both builder launches received the configured image path as argument three, but neither regenerate nor repair effect detail named the image and its digest.

items.name: A start whose configured builder image is not in the builder images directory is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: The configured builder-clojure image was absent; start-run refused builder-image-missing and run-progress returned null, with no builder launched.

items.name: Two runs on one store compare the second cycle with the first
items.rule: Measurement keeps its history across runs on the one store, so a scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of its selection
items.evidence: Both cycles passed on one store and the second stamp recorded no new identities, but C-2’s scoreboard reported previous-cycle-id null instead of C-1.

items.name: An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The required gate result was not recorded.

items.name: A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command ran once in the repository with empty candidate scope and evidence directory, a separate candidate copy, and no candidate launch; the gate event matched the install digest and reported the requested budget, poll and probe line.

items.name: A gate command that exits 1 naming a reason fails the attempt with that reason, and the repair builder is handed its evidence
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: Attempt 1 recorded suite-red and attempt 2 passed; the first event’s detail included the reason prefix (“suite-red 3 of 65 tests failed”) instead of the required “3 of 65 tests failed”.

items.name: A gate command whose last line is a refusal to grade is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command returned seam-answered-before-boot three times; each gate refusal was followed by a recorded gate-refusal and the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure.

items.name: A gate command whose last line names no code the runner reads halts the run at the gate
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command exited 2 with infrastructure text; progress halted at gate with that detail and no gate result, fail-cycle or concluded cycle.

items.name: The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: Three runs with no gate command, gate-a and gate-b recorded three different harness digests; the first exactly matched SHA-256 of config bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order.

items.name: Each effect a run records lies inside the leaf of the tree named for that effect
items.rule: The run is one ORC tree, cycle.v1, and each effect the runner performs is a leaf of its own
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The fixture could not reach scoring to inspect all eleven leaves.

items.name: A candidate that refuses its first three requests is answered on a later poll, its margin 20 less that poll
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The fixture configured the delayed HTTP responses, but the runner never launched the server.

items.name: Each gate attempt runs as a child tick of its own of the workflow "cycle-runner/gate-attempt.v1"
items.rule: A gate attempt is one subtree, delegated once per attempt
items.evidence: The runner halted at the gate with “Built-in gate not implemented; LOYLY_GATE_CMD is required.” The fixture configured the first suite red and the next green, but no gate attempt ran.

items.name: A copy of the candidate in a folder of its own, with no spec around it, runs a cycle
items.rule: The runner carries its own event model, as its room gave it
items.evidence: A candidate copy ran from a temporary folder outside every .pi ancestor and reached the gate; it halted because the built-in gate is unimplemented, instead of recording a gate pass and passing the cycle.

items.name: The judge scores each item in a child tick of its own, the scores are filed as scored, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: On a fresh retry the judge scored 01-001 as 1.0 and 01-002 as 0.0 in distinct grade.v1 child ticks, and Measurement filed booked/no receipt as one of two passing; the run passed.

items.name: Each item's grading starts with no other item's evidence
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The first researcher returned E-ONE and its judge request contained it; neither the second researcher request nor the second judge request contained E-ONE.

items.name: The researcher is given the item, the seam and the event model, and a shell in the grading room only
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The first researcher request contained the fixture scenario, seam and event model. Its shell reported Linux and a grading room holding plan, config and impl; ls of its parent showed only that grading room.

items.name: A judge reply with the level of a pass and no reasoning scores nothing, and the item is filed unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: A judge reply for 01-002 with level 2 but no reasoning left only the 01-001 score in progress and the store; Measurement filed 01-002 unreached and one of two passing.

items.name: A sealed grader whose digest the run did not approve halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: A run grades only with the approved sealed grader
items.evidence: A rubric digest absent from approved r-1 halted at grader with its SHA-256 digest in detail; there was no self-check, fence or builder.

items.name: No item scored fails the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The model rejected both researchers after a passing command gate; file-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts, fail-score-stage recorded, and the cycle failed at score without another builder.

items.name: A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it
items.rule: A run stopped with its runner resumes where it stopped
items.evidence: After the runner and sleeping builder were stopped and the same store reopened, progress remained running for 90 polling seconds and the builder log showed only its first session launch; the run did not resume to completion.

items.name: The builder's instruction is the rendered text, and the repair's adds only the closing paragraph
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The first instruction file was exactly INSTRUCTION-7; the second appended one closing paragraph naming the previous candidate and gate evidence paths.

items.name: A render the model does not reply to halts the run before any builder
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The model stub rejected the render request; progress halted at render with effect-could-not-run and no regenerate, fail-cycle, cycle, or builder launch.

items.name: Reading a running run shows its tick and the leaves it completed
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: While the builder slept, progress showed R-1 running with its tick ID, completed fence and render nodes, and regenerate marked running last.
